## Load Samples

```{r}

sample_files <- list.files(
  file.path(dataPath, "raw_counts"),
  pattern = "raw_counts\\.tsv\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

print(sample_files)


print(paste("Input data:", dataPath))

totalBefore <- 0
totalCells <- 0

```

## Processing

```{r}

for (file in sample_files) {
  
  # sample ID from file name
  parts <- strsplit(basename(file), "_")[[1]]
  sID <- parts[3]
  
  resDir <- paste0(mainDir, "/", sID, "_res")
  
  if (!file.exists(resDir)) {
    dir.create(resDir)
  }
  
  print(paste("Processing: ", sID))
  
  counts <- fread(file)
  
  counts <- as.data.frame(counts)
  
  rownames(counts) <- counts[,1]
  
  counts <- counts[,-1]
  
  counts <- as(as.matrix(counts), "dgCMatrix")
  
  cb <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    min.cells = 5,
    min.features = 300,
    project = sID
  )
  
  cb[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(cb, pattern = "^MT-")

  print("QC report...")
  
  # Violin plots
  
  violin_plot_mt <- VlnPlot(cb, features = c("percent.mt")) +
    labs(y = "Percent UMIs from Mitochondria") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 30), linetype = "dashed") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
  
  violin_plot_gene <- VlnPlot(cb, features = c("nFeature_RNA")) +
    labs(y = "Feature RNAs") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 30), linetype = "dashed") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  violin_plot_umi <- VlnPlot(cb, features = c("nCount_RNA")) +
    labs(y = "RNA counts") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 30), linetype = "dashed") +
    patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  combined_violin <- violin_plot_mt | violin_plot_gene | violin_plot_umi
  combined_violin
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "violin_plot_initial.png"), 
         plot = combined_violin,
         width = 12, 
         height = 4)
  
  ndim = 10
  
  # Histogram
  
  plot_data <- FetchData(
    object = cb,
    vars = c("percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA")
  )
  
  hist_plot_mt <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = percent.mt)) + 
                    geom_histogram() +
                    labs(x = "Percent UMIs from Mitochondria")
  
  hist_plot_gene <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = nFeature_RNA)) + 
                    geom_histogram() +
                    labs(x = "Feature RNAs")
  
  hist_plot_umi <- ggplot(data = plot_data, mapping = aes(x = nCount_RNA)) + 
                    geom_histogram() +
                    labs(x = "RNA Counts")
  
  combined_hist <- hist_plot_mt | hist_plot_gene | hist_plot_umi
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "hist_plot_initial.png"),
         plot = combined_hist)
  
  # Scatter plots
  
  plot1 <- FeatureScatter(cb, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
  plot2 <- FeatureScatter(cb, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

  combinedScatter <- plot1 + plot2
  combinedScatter

  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "combinedScatter.png"),
         plot = combinedScatter, width = 20, height = 8, bg = "white")
  
  # Filter
  
  totalBefore <- totalBefore + ncol(cb)
  
  mdata <- cb@meta.data
  
  print("Filtering...")
  
  print(paste0("before filter: ", ncol(cb)))
  
  lower_feature_cutoff <- 300
  upper_feature_cutoff <- 4000

  lower_umi_cutoff <- 300
  upper_umi_cutoff <- 8000

  cb <- subset(cb, subset = percent.mt < 5 & 
                 nFeature_RNA <= upper_feature_cutoff &
                 nFeature_RNA >= lower_feature_cutoff &
                 nCount_RNA <= upper_umi_cutoff &
                 nCount_RNA >= lower_umi_cutoff)
  
  print(paste0("after filter: ", ncol(cb)))
  
  totalCells <- totalCells + ncol(cb)
  
  # Normalize
  
  print("Normalization...")
  cb <- NormalizeData(object = cb,
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                      scale.factor = 10000 )
  
  # Find Variable Genes
  
  print("Finding Variable Features...")
  cb <- FindVariableFeatures(
    cb,
    selection.method = "mean.var.plot",
    mean.cutoff = c(0.0125, 3),
    dispersion.cutoff = c(0.5, Inf)
  )

  print(paste0("# Features: ", length(VariableFeatures(cb)))) # check num genes

  cb <- ScaleData(object = cb, verbose = TRUE)

  print("Dimensionality reduction...")
  cb <- RunPCA(
    cb,
    features = VariableFeatures(cb),
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  PC_ElbowPlot <- ElbowPlot(cb, ndims = 20)
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "PC_ElbowPlot.png"), plot = PC_ElbowPlot, width = 12, height = 8, bg = "white")

  set.seed(42)
  
  cb <- FindNeighbors(
    cb,
    dims = 1:ndim,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  cb <- FindClusters(
    cb,
    resolution = 0.75,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  print("Check clusters...")
  table(Idents(cb))
  levels(Idents(cb))
  
  print("tSNE...")
  
  cb <- RunTSNE(
    cb,
    dims = 1:ndim,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  tSNE_plot <- DimPlot(
    cb,
    reduction = "tsne",
    label = TRUE
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "tSNE_Plot.png"), 
         plot = tSNE_plot,
         width = 8,
         height = 6,
         bg = "white")
  

  print("UMAP...")

  cb <- RunUMAP(
    cb,
    dims = 1:ndim,
    verbose = FALSE,
    seed.use = 42
  )

  umap_plot <- DimPlot(
    cb,
    reduction = "umap"
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "UMAP_Plot.png"),
         plot = umap_plot,
         width = 8,
         height = 6,
         bg = "white")
  

  print("Find DEGs...")
  cb.markers <- FindAllMarkers(
    cb,
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25
  )

  top10 <- cb.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 10)

  top10_per_cluster_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
    cb,
    features = top10$gene
  )
  
  ggsave(file.path(resDir, "top10_per_cluster_heatmap.png"), 
         plot = top10_per_cluster_heatmap,
         width = 12,
         height = 4,
         bg = "white")


  print("Save result...")
  saveRDS(
    cb,
    file.path(resDir, paste0(sID, "_object.rds"))
  )


  print("Save expression...")

  clCounts <- extractClusterMatrix(cb)

  write.table(
    clCounts,
    file.path(resDir, paste0(sID, "_cluster_expr_counts.txt")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
  )

  # rpkmData <- convToRpkm(clCounts,geneLengths)
  # write.table(rpkmData, paste0(resDir,sId,"_cluster_expr_RPKM.txt"),sep="\t",quote = F)

  print("Done!")

}

```
